title: Tilted phone to laptop tour with typed captions
summary: Dark, silent 30 s promo: a mark lockup, three tilted phone close-ups each paired with a short green caption typed letter by letter, a four-line stacked statement, then a laptop pull-out and a closing mark.
use_when: A consumer app that ships on phone and desktop and wants one film for both
Silent autoplay feeds where green-on-black captions carry the message
You have 3 phone screenshots and 1 desktop screenshot, no UI rebuild
A dark brand with one saturated accent colour

look.type_style: captions: bold rounded grotesk, sentence case, 7-9 % H, accent green on black, set on the device's tilted plane; stacked statement: extended heavy grotesk caps, 4 lines, 7 % H rising to 10 % H on the last line

sfx.event: zoom-through exit of the third phone shot

notes: Silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Every shot enters and leaves through black (fade ~6-15 fr) instead of cuts; only one hard cut (16.23). Captions type on letter by letter without a caret (proposed term letter-type-on); the opener lockup mark wipes in and the word slides out of it (proposed term mark-slide-lockup). Black hold 20.00-21.77 is deliberate. Timings from 4 fps sheets, ±0.25 s.
